cold_cache_footprint_note: ~18.4 GB. The 676 MB checkpoint alone is NOT the footprint; four upstream encoders dominate.

capability_contract_verified_against_off.output: predicted fMRI BOLD time series, shape (n_timesteps, n_vertices)
capability_contract_verified_against_off.subject: average/population subject — NOT the user
capability_contract_verified_against_off.hemodynamic_lag: predictions offset by 5 seconds in the past to compensate for hemodynamic lag
capability_contract_verified_against_off.text_pipeline: text is converted to speech then transcribed to obtain word-level timings
